title: Non-Markovian dynamics of the giant atom beyond the rotating-wave approximation
summary: We study the non-Markovian dynamics of a giant artificial atom coupled to a one-dimensional acoustic waveguide beyond the rotating-wave and weak-coupling approximations. By combining an optimized ESPRIT-based decomposition of the bath correlation function with the hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM), we achieve numerically exact simulations in regimes with long memory times, finite temperature, and strong system-bath coupling.
